title: A Demon that remembers: An agential approach towards quantum thermodynamics of temporal correlations
summary: This thesis develops a decision-theoretic framework for extracting thermodynamic work from temporal correlations in quantum systems. We model a classical agent -- lacking quantum memory -- performing adaptive work extraction through continuous inference and decision-making under uncertainty. By introducing $ρ^*$-ideal protocols, we demonstrate that exploiting memory effects allows adaptive strategies to surpass non-adaptive bounds.
